## **Bugs et stabilité** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      9 avis récents mentionnent bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 15 juil. 2026 - 18 sept. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent des crashes ou de l'instabilité. À traiter comme actionnable seulement en cas de pic ou après une mise à jour ; sinon souvent du bruit de baseline.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Alexa Reizla_, 18 sept. 2026, 1/5: "Every update breaks yet an other thing. And for the 3rd time I CANNOT open a password protected file 'cause it returns to the main open file screen. With that, after the last 3 updates the performance dropped significantly - it became very slow. Time to switch to something better I guess"
            2. _m pe_, 14 sept. 2026, 2/5: "won't properly paste from FUTO keyboard (pinned) & other text items, had to paste in note app them copy again. I appreciate you removed bugs recently but having to constantly make a copy of the document as everything is set to view only even though the file on LO Linux was editable is a recurring pain.No find and replace, couldn't search for case sensitive word.I do appreciate the dark mode though."
            3. _Jim_, 15 juil. 2026, 2/5: "The PDF format is not listed amongst the supported document types. Furthermore, the app has major problems when closing documents; it either takes an age to do so or freezes completely and crashes. And whilst using the app, pages – even though they have already loaded correctly and are still visible via their thumbnails – often become inaccessible after just a few seconds. Even scrolling manually does not display the individual page."
<!--/ir-theme-->
